Optional Immersive Translate integration

This public source and installer DO NOT include the proprietary vendor userscript.
The adjacent host.html and desktop/src/immersive-* adapters are first-party code.

Official homepage: https://immersivetranslate.com/
Supported user-provided userscript version: 1.33.1
Required SHA-256: 9ec40a25e5fd479a4c4a460905ba0bc25b888469f781c74df5e90016bec4ac81

Users must obtain the original supported script themselves from an authorized
vendor distribution, subject to the vendor's terms. In an account's translation
settings, choose “导入官方脚本文件” and select that local file. The application
verifies its pinned SHA-256 before storing it in the current local application
data directory under optional-integrations/immersive-translate.user.js.
No automatic download, unknown-script execution, installation or paid signup occurs.
Missing, incompatible or modified files leave translation unavailable with a
clear message. Collection, posting and account nurture remain available.
After import, explicitly enable translation and configure the desired provider.
Any vendor prompts, account access, API settings and charges remain the user's choice.

Only copied plain chat text enters a separate isolated translation document;
account cookies and task handles never enter the adapter. The application does
not install a Chrome Web Store extension or claim vendor endorsement.
Public native tests use a first-party synthetic adapter and real Electron IPC;
they test adapter lifecycle/isolation, not proprietary vendor behavior or online
translation quality. Users may validate the optional supported script separately.
